liquidity_and_capacity.note: At 1% hourly volume participation, even the 5th percentile hour exceeds the 0.04 unit grid order size; however, in May-Nov 2026 NVDAUSDT traded at 128-243 USDT, so 0.04 units requires 5.1-9.7 USDT collateral, exceeding the Demo 7.00 USDT cap in most historical weeks. Historical replay uses 10.00 USDT 1x risk budget, matching R08 Section 6.1.

demo_vs_mainnet_comparison.finding: Official Binance Demo experienced hourly settlements averaging ~22.97 bps/h during weekend US-equity market closure, whereas Binance Mainnet settled every 8h with much smaller rates (mostly 0 bps over the weekend). Therefore funding studies MUST evaluate both actual Mainnet funding AND Demo/high-funding stress regimes separately.
